items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 125:1
items.html: (To the question) What are existence and standing? There are two kinds of influx from Aba and Ima: one is from the aspect of giving life to the worlds, and it is also called the influx of existence and standing, and this influx comes from the aspect of the coupling that does not cease of Aba and Ima, namely, from Aba and Ima of the stature of SAG. And the second is the influx of blessing and the dainties of kings, namely, the Mochin of birth, and this influx comes from Aba and Ima of the stature of AB, whose coupling ceases and is not fixed, but only at the time that ZON rise to them as MAN, as is known.
